snippet.title: Adventures of Tom Sawyer (NES) Gameplay 240p | No Commentary - SETA, Aug 1989 (Original Hardware)
snippet.description:
Adventures of Tom Sawyer was released for Nintendo's classic 8-bit NES console in August 1989. All audio/visual elements copyright 1989, SETA. Music composed by ?

https://nesguide.com/games/adventures-of-tom-sawyer/

This video was produced for NESguide.com - a website that attempts to organize the NES catalog and make it easy to explore. Gameplays from this channel are featured throughout the NESguide website to showcase the original basic mechanics and audio/visual design of each title. Thank you for your continued support of this project, since 2007!


ABOUT ADVENTURES OF TOM SAWYER (NES)

Tom Sawyer is dreaming, and in this dream he must save Becky from Injun Joe, he must travel through six stages to get to her. He encounters various creatures including a Giant Octopus, a Giant Aligator in the Mississippi River, Ghosts and Ghouls in a haunted house, a flying cloud-man, and a dragon.
